summary:
Results-driven Senior Software Developer with 9+ years of expertise in leading mobile application development teams. Proven track record of delivering high-performance, secure mobile solutions in fintech and enterprise systems while mentoring and leading development teams. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Management Information Systems, combining technical expertise with business acumen for effective team leadership and strategic decision-making. Core competencies include:

• Technical Leadership: Led and mentored mobile development teams, driving innovation, best practices, and achieving 95% sprint completion rates
• Native Android Development: Expert in Java and Kotlin, Android SDK, Material Design, Jetpack Compose, Jetpack Components
• Cross-Platform Development: Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android, BLoC pattern, state management
• Mobile Architecture: MVVM, Clean Architecture, Repository Pattern, Dependency Injection
• Payment Systems: PCI-DSS compliant mobile payment solutions, MPOS, TapOnPhone, SoftPOS
• Security & Compliance: Secure payment processing, encryption, biometric authentication
• Team Management: Cross-functional collaboration, code reviews, technical mentoring, architecture decisions
• Business Acumen: Management Information Systems background enabling effective alignment of technical solutions with business objectives

Key Achievements:
• Led mobile development team for applications processing $50M+ monthly transactions with 99.99% uptime
• Led and mentored mobile development teams, achieving 95% sprint completion rate and fostering technical growth
• Implemented PCI-DSS compliant payment solutions for international banks
• Led development of merchant platform applications onboarding 50K+ users
• Improved application performance by 60% through technical optimization
• Established mobile development standards, best practices, and architectural patterns across teams
